author: 52 comments
text: 1d FAM JAM WAS A BANGER!!!! Bring Your Parents to Work Day is one of Clay’s oldest traditions, and it still gets us a little emotional ;') This year, we: - Made parents pitch Clay to Varun Anand in front of a live audience (winners get to take their kids out on Clay’s dollar). - Had parents explain what their kids do for a living. - Had parents tell stories while the audience guessed which coworker they raised. - Let parents roam the office before we move up the block to 11 Madison. - Fueled the whole thing with dot cake and endless lattes. Much love to everyone who came, and especially Mishti Sharma (who's hosted this thing 3 years in a row), Sarah Khasrovi, Jessica Jin, Tess Hokin, Erin Zarr, Puneet Sabharwal, Tess Liberman, Jake Block, and brad haft who helped make everything (down to the costume runway and these 90's yearbook photos) smooth as butter. (pictured: pages from the yearbook we put together, full of FAMILY LORRRRRRRRRREEEEEEEEEEEEE and tea, messages for their kids, HAGS-type stuff, and doodles only dad would draw 👴) THANKS FAMMMMMMMMMMMM <3 ps: shoutout the talented photog Reece Taylor Williams 329 52 Comments Like Comment Share Clay 1d Having the fam around makes a cold New York feel a little warmer <3 Like Reply 1 Reaction Clay 1d was awesome meeting you Marina Choumanova, Bruce Dinopoulos, george mironis <3 Like Reply Japheth Franco 1d How do I have FOMO and I'm not even an employee? author: merriamwebster
text: When John Milton needed a name for the gathering place of all demons for "Paradise Lost," he turned to the classics as any sensible 17th-century writer would. 'Pandæmonium,' as the capital of Hell is known in the epic poem, combines the Greek prefix 'pan-', meaning “all,” with the Late Latin 'daemonium,' meaning “evil spirit.”

author: GaryVee
text: I’m constantly baffled that people don’t understand that it is a volume and skill game to get followers, awareness, attention, and sales on social media. Too many people here are insecure and are overthinking their posts and, more importantly, only posting once every day, every other day, once a week. They are upset that they’re not getting the results they’re looking for. You’re not consistent. You’re not doing it the right way. You’re not doing it enough. #garyvee #socialmedia #growth
